theory_mapping.povm_construction: Set-conditioned square-root measurement with explicit null is correct. S = Σ k_j k_j† + ridge I, G = S^(-1/2), token weights |k_j† G q_i|², null = ridge q_i† S^(-1) q_i. No token-only softmax or weight renormalization. Context = attention @ V, null value zero.
theory_mapping.circuit_encoding: ThreeQubitMap: 8->6 input angles π tanh(projection(features)), two layers local Rz/Ry/Rz + fixed CZ ring. Query/key share structure, 144 nominal parameters total (2×(6×8 + 6 bias) + 2×(2×3×3 rotations)) = 2×72 = 144. Correct.
theory_mapping.inverse_root_gradient: Loewner divided difference for f(x)=x^(-1/2) in complex128/float64, avoiding eigenvector gradient singularity at repeated eigenvalues. Backward formula -1/(λ_i λ_j (λ_i+λ_j)) is correct for first derivatives. Eigenvector gradients not supported; limitation documented.
theory_mapping.mode_contracts: Five modes with same seed/warm-start/factual CE/epoch order/update count: disabled (original softmax), quantum (full POVM+null), fidelity (pairwise fidelity without set Gram), diagonal (off-diagonal dropped before Gram), key_mismatch (cyclic permutation of valid keys, values unchanged). Correct isolation.
theory_mapping.bounds: Canary 12/6/6 synthetic, seed13, 2 epochs. Screen 630/631/587 Re-TACRED subset, seeds [13,29,53,71,97], 8 warmup + 6 intervention epochs, batch16, microbatch2. No full-data mode. Correct boundary.
theory_mapping.validation_gate: Requires docs/validation/q_srm_review.json with scope=both, acceptable verdict, matching source_sha256 before execution. Source/data/config/environment change rejects resume. Correct binding.

correctness.povm_completeness: Explicit check Σ effects + null_effect = I in validate_trace, atol=1e-9. Effects PSD verified by eigvalsh ≥ -1e-9. Born probabilities sum to 1 (token + null) within 1e-9. Mask support enforced: padded queries have attention=0, null=1. Correct.
correctness.circuit_lineage: validate_trace checks _circuit NumPy replay against plugin_*_circuit_states for query/key independently. Angles π tanh(projection), gate sequence Ry/Rz per wire, then 2 layers Rz/Ry/Rz + CZ sign. Final state [query|key]_state matches circuit_states[...,-1,:]. Norm conservation Σ|ψ|²=1 at every stage, atol=1e-12. Correct.
correctness.gram_and_inverse_root: validate_trace: gram = Σ (key_density * mask) + ridge I. Spectral decomposition eigenvalues>0 (PSD input). inverse_root G = U Λ^(-1/2) U†. Check effects = G @ (key_density * mask) @ G per token. Null_effect = ridge G @ G. Completeness Σ effects + null_effect = I verified element-wise, atol=1e-9. Correct construction.
correctness.born_rule: validate_trace independent POVM quadratic form: attention_ref = q† @ effects @ q (real part), null_ref = ridge q† @ G G† @ q. Matches stored attention/null_probability within 1e-9. Fidelity mode: f = |q† k|² per pair, denom = Σ f + ridge, attention = f / denom, null = ridge / denom. Diagonal mode: element-wise real diagonal Gram. All modes verified against explicit matrix expressions. Correct.
correctness.key_mismatch: Permutation vector permutation[row, valid_indices] = valid_indices.roll(1). Key states permuted, values unchanged, so attention support same but context differs. validate_trace checks attention.sum(-1) unchanged vs quantum. Correct cyclic control.
correctness.fidelity_mode: Pairwise |q† k|² without set Gram. No effects/inverse_root/completeness in this mode. validate_trace checks fidelity array against |q.conj() @ k.T|² and denominator = fidelity.sum(-1) + ridge. Attention = fidelity / denom, null = ridge / denom. Correct bypass of set construction.
correctness.disabled_exact_base: test_disabled_exact_base_output_and_classifier_gradient: SRMModel(base, 'disabled') returns identical logits and classifier gradients (rtol=0, atol=0) to original base. Encoder frozen, only classifier requires_grad. Correct passthrough.
correctness.parameter_budget: test_144_nominal_parameters_and_unitary_state_lineage: sum(kernel.parameters().numel()) == 144 for all active modes. Query/key maps each: Linear(8,6) = 54 params, rotations(2,3,3) = 18 params. Total per map = 72. Two maps = 144. Correct count.
correctness.probability_support: test_complete_probabilities_mask_and_parameter_gradient: attention.sum(-1) + null_probability = 1 (atol=1e-11). attention ≥ 0, null ≥ 0, null ≤ 1. Padded attention entries = 0. Parameter gradients finite and nonzero. Effects PSD (eigvalsh ≥ -1e-11). Completeness |max| < 1e-11. Correct.
correctness.gradient_exactness: test_exact_classical_expression_values_and_gradients: autograd gradients of POVM Born rule (q,k -> attention) match independent explicit quadratic form q† effects q gradients (atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-9). Inverse root backward uses Loewner formula. test_inverse_root_gradcheck_at_repeated_eigenvalues and unequal_spectrum_and_batch pass torch.autograd.gradcheck. Correct first-order autodiff.
correctness.context_bypass: test_context_really_bypasses_softmax_and_preserves_null: observed['context'] == (attention @ value).float() exactly (rtol=0, atol=0). attention.sum(-1) ≠ 1 (null>0 present). No second softmax. Correct direct weighted sum.
correctness.microbatch_gradient: test_microbatch_gradients_match_logical_factual_ce: full batch gradient matches sum of per-sample (loss/count).backward() gradients across microbatches, atol=1e-7, rtol=2e-4. Correct gradient accumulation.

fidelity_gaps.classical_equivalence: Finite-dimensional POVM has exact classical matrix expression verified in validate_trace. Theory states no quantum advantage claim. Novelty unresolved. Acceptable as bounded mechanism validation, not capability proof.
fidelity_gaps.effective_capacity: Nominal 144 parameters shared across heads. Theory notes parameter count ≠ effective capacity. Fidelity/diagonal modes alter Gram construction; key_mismatch permutes keys. No claim these preserve effective degrees of freedom. Gap documented.
fidelity_gaps.gradient_order: Inverse root backward supports first derivatives only. Eigenvector gradients unsupported at repeated eigenvalues. Higher-order derivatives or Hessian queries not addressed. Acceptable for Adam first-order training.
fidelity_gaps.complex_precision: Forward spectral decomposition uses complex128/float64. Base model float32. Intermediate cast to double for POVM, cast back to float32 for context. Numerical validation uses atol=1e-6 to 1e-9. Acceptable for bounded screen; production deployment precision not claimed.
fidelity_gaps.cuda_unverified: Owner has no visible GPU at validation. CUDA path untested. Canary gate enforces collaborator must pass synthetic CUDA before screen. Host observation: first shell run had OOM due to preflight memory retention. New isolated_preflight exits subprocess before training. Correctness acceptable pending collaborator CUDA canary; no owner CUDA lifecycle claim.
fidelity_gaps.trace_population: 10 samples per condition: 3 splits × (initial/best/final) replay + train update0. validate_trace checks 50 samples, ≥250 full arrays per mode (5 modes × 50 = 250 minimum). Structural contract correct. Population not intended as formal statistical evidence.
fidelity_gaps.disabled_baseline: Disabled uses original softmax; Q-CFRA multi-view loss not reusable as same-group control. Historical disabled results not valid screen baseline. Theory explicitly states no formal utility conclusion from bounded screen. Acceptable as mechanism validation baseline.

control_fairness.shared_warmstart: validate_trace checks all conditions in same seed have identical base_state_sha256 after warmup. Warmup trained on shared CE, no intervention. Correct common initialization.
control_fairness.seed_isolation: Each seed's warmup/conditions use independent torch.manual_seed(seed) and seed_all(seed+1000 for intervention). Epoch order deterministic from seed. Correct isolation.
control_fairness.epoch_order: epoch_order(count, seed, epoch): randperm with seed+epoch. Epoch 0 moves index(0) to position 0, preserving population. validate_trace checks next_indexes match protocol cursor. Correct frozen order.
control_fairness.update_indexes: update_indexes(count, logical, update, seed): divmod(update, ceil(count/logical)) gives epoch/position. Select from epoch_order[position*logical:(position+1)*logical]. Correct deterministic sampling.
control_fairness.factual_ce_only: objective(logits, gold) returns cross_entropy(logits, gold). No counterfactual JS, attention regularization, or multi-view terms. config 'loss': 'factual_cross_entropy_only'. Correct isolation.
control_fairness.validation_selection: Best checkpoint selected by valid Macro-F1. Test evaluation only after training complete, no selection. per_class, confusion_matrix included in report. Correct post-hoc test access.
control_fairness.key_mismatch_parity: Gate: mismatch_parity_tolerance 0.001. Aggregate checks mean(quantum - key_mismatch) ≤ threshold. If violated, quantum_attribution remains 'not established'. Correct mechanism attribution gate, not task utility.

gradient_and_numerics.inverse_root_stability: Hermitian symmetrization: hermitian = (matrix + matrix.mH)/2. Eigenvalues checked >0 before sqrt. Ridge 0.01 ensures positive-definite input. Loewner formula -1/(λ_i λ_j (√λ_i + √λ_j)²) avoids eigenvalue-gap divisor. Correct regularization.
gradient_and_numerics.gradient_symmetry: Backward (grad_output + grad_output.mH)/2 ensures Hermitian gradient. Correct for real loss functions.
gradient_and_numerics.circuit_precision: Gate arithmetic in torch.float64/complex128. Input angles cast from float32 projection. Final state complex128. Numerical checks use atol=1e-12 for norm conservation. Correct precision for spectral operations.
gradient_and_numerics.determinism: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True). OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8. seed_all(seed) sets random/numpy/torch/cuda RNG. checkpoint stores/restores rng_state. Correct deterministic path.
gradient_and_numerics.microbatch_accumulation: Gradient computed per microbatch, loss/count scaled correctly. optimizer.step() once after all micros. test_microbatch_gradients_match_logical_factual_ce passes. Correct accumulation.
gradient_and_numerics.nonfinite_gate: train_update checks torch.isfinite(loss) and all param gradients. Raises ValueError on nonfinite. Correct safety.
gradient_and_numerics.mask_enforcement: measure() validates mask.any(-1).all() (no empty support). attention[..., ~mask] = 0. Null = 1 for padded queries. validate_trace checks attention padding and null values. Correct masking.
gradient_and_numerics.padding_invariance: test_token_permutation_and_padding_invariance: attention/null unchanged when valid tokens permuted or padded tokens appended. Correct mask-based support.

lifecycle_correctness.checkpoint_schema: Schema 'srm-worker.v1' includes fingerprint, seed, mode, base_state_sha256, next_update, selected_through, next_indexes, best_model, best_metric, best_update, model, optimizer, rng. cfra_checkpoint.save/load uses atomic write + fsync + rename. Two generations retained (latest/previous pointer). Correct structure.
lifecycle_correctness.resume_binding: Worker.__init__ checks resumed state: schema, fingerprint, seed, mode, base_state_sha256, next_update, next_indexes must match. RNG restored. Raises ValueError on mismatch. Correct binding.
lifecycle_correctness.cursor_semantics: next_update is the next logical minibatch to execute. selected_through is last completed selection epoch. Resume loads state, verifies next_indexes == indexes(), continues from next_update. Correct cursor.
lifecycle_correctness.best_retention: best_model stored as detached CPU state_dict. best_metric, best_update tracked. Final stage loads best_model before final snapshot. Correct checkpoint selection.
lifecycle_correctness.trace_completeness: Writer adds initial (before any training), best (after loading best_model), final (after final update), and update0 (actual first train step). validate_trace checks coverage: (train/valid/test) × (initial/best/final) replay + (train, update0, training) = 10 samples. trace_completeness set to 'complete' only after all samples written. Correct contract.
lifecycle_correctness.completed_marker: RUN_COMPLETE.json includes fingerprint, seed, mode, updates, files (with sha256). completed() checks marker exists, identity matches, all required files present with matching hashes. Correct immutability gate.
lifecycle_correctness.export_atomicity: export() creates tempfile.mkdtemp, writes all files, injects failure if requested, then renames directory. Failed export cleans temporary directory. Immutable source reexport checks existing receipt/content. Correct atomic publication.
lifecycle_correctness.tamper_rejection: validate_trace checks artifact sha256 before every read. read_values rehashes on each access. Checkpoint loading verifies pointer sha256. test_real_parent_resume_export_failure_and_tamper: damaged checkpoint generation raises ValueError on hash check. Correct tamper detection.
lifecycle_correctness.failure_recovery: cfra_checkpoint.load(recover_previous=True) restores pointer['previous'] if pointer['latest'] damaged. Q-SRM runner does not call recover_previous; damage raises error immediately. Manual recovery possible but not automatic. Test demonstrates checkpoint_recovery.json written if previous generation restored. Correct behavior for explicit rollback, not silent fallback.
lifecycle_correctness.host_rerun_status: Host observation: first shell run OOM exit-9 due to preflight Torch/CUDA retention in parent. New isolated_preflight runs validation in subprocess, exits before training, inherited env not serialized. Correctness verified in code. Host will rerun exact new-source real shell test before final acceptance. Pending collaborator CUDA canary, no claim current lifecycle passed.

artifact_and_recovery.trace_schema: sample-trace.v2 with task_contract: required_roles [sentence, tokens, subject, object, correct_relation, predicted_relation, checkpoint_identity, input_provenance]. required_representations includes all common/POVM fields. required_value_representations same list. required_splits [train, valid, test]. required_checkpoints [initial, best, final]. required_lanes [replay, training]. Correct v2 contract.
artifact_and_recovery.value_capture: Each representation has value_capture with status='complete', shape, logical_element_count, stored_element_count (both equal to array.size), artifact_refs (full .npy file), reader_projection (coordinate_inspector, arbitrary access, source_sha256 matching artifact). validate_trace verifies all fields. Correct complete capture.
artifact_and_recovery.reader_projection: read_values(trace_path, sample_id, name, prefix, component='real'/'imag'): rehashes artifact, loads mmap, checks shape/dtype, returns np.asarray(array[prefix]).copy(). Supports arbitrary coordinate access. validate_trace tests corner coordinates (all 0, all shape-1) for real/imag components. Correct arbitrary access.
artifact_and_recovery.inventory_frozen: inventory(mode) returns fixed list per mode. validate_trace checks set(trace required_value_representations) == expected inventory. Rejects omitted/extra fields. Correct frozen list.
artifact_and_recovery.independent_replay: validate_trace uses NumPy _circuit() to recompute angles/states from parameters, checks against plugin_query/key_circuit_states (atol=1e-5). Checks embedding lineage, attention @ value = context (atol=1e-6). Checks Born rule against explicit q† effects q (atol=1e-9). Checks fidelity |q† k|² and denom. Checks POVM completeness. All lineages independently reproduced. Correct NumPy replay.
artifact_and_recovery.lineage_edges: validate_trace checks: embedding = token + position (atol=3e-6). attention @ value = context (atol=2e-6). parameter_after - parameter_before = parameter_delta (atol=1e-7). attention.sum(-1) + null = 1 (atol=1e-9). logit softmax = probabilities. gold matches label_map. entity masks match roles.span. Correct dataflow edges.
artifact_and_recovery.hash_binding: All artifacts include sha256 in artifact_refs. validate_trace rehashes before load. reader_projection.source_sha256 list matches artifact hashes. value_capture.artifact_refs same as representation.artifact_refs. Correct hash binding.
artifact_and_recovery.semantic_gates: validate_trace checks: attention normalization (sum=1 with null, valid ≥0). No attention on padded keys. PSD effects (eigvalsh ≥ -1e-9). Completeness |max| ≤ 1e-9. Unit state norm (atol=1e-7). Gold/prediction consistency. Correct semantic invariants.
artifact_and_recovery.export_whitelist: export() writes summary.json, manifest.json, trace_validation.json, receipt.json. No raw data/checkpoints/predictions/sentences. receipt.json includes fingerprint, sha256 dict, raw_artifacts_included=false. validate_report checks REPORT_FILES exact set. Correct whitelist.
artifact_and_recovery.immutable_retry: export() checks destination.exists(). If yes, validates existing receipt/content match. If identical, returns existing receipt. If different, raises ValueError. Never overwrites changed report. tempfile cleaned on failure. Correct immutability.
artifact_and_recovery.report_validation: validate_report(target): checks REPORT_FILES exact set, no symlinks, sha256 in run_summary.json matches actual files. manifest fingerprint matches run_summary. No symlinked reports root. Correct report structure.
artifact_and_recovery.recovery_evidence: test_real_parent_resume_export_failure_and_tamper: stop-after pauses at update 2, resume continues with identical model/optimizer/rng/cursor. Export failure cleans temp, retry succeeds, immutable source unchanged before/after. Checkpoint tamper detected. Lifecycle passed modulo host rerun. Correct recovery contracts.
